videos.title: Connecting Africa
videos.description: The International Energy Agency has found that nearly two billion people globally still cook using wood, charcoal and other polluting fuels, and roughly half of them live in Africa; its "Clean Cooking in Africa 2026" report also found that household air pollution contributes to around 2.5 million premature deaths globally each year; we look at some of the solutions and technologies being developed to solve its clean-cooking crisis.

videos.title: African Voices Playmakers
videos.description: NBA legend Hakeem Olajuwon joins Larry Madowo to look back on his extraordinary journey from Lagos to basketball greatness, the Dream Shake that became his signature and his enduring influence on today's NBA stars, while sharing how faith remains at the heart of his life and legacy.
